name: Weekly cash and monthly close
description: One saved procedure catalog for an in-house finance contact and the external preparation team. Select the named set when creating each period.

resources.title: Named responsibilities and existing accounting policy
resources.text: Replace this note with the actual preparer, reviewer, backup and client contact. Link the firm's current accounting and reporting instructions. The procedure records their work, answers and decisions.

steps.title: Confirm the period and source files
steps.instructions: Match the requested period, client and source-file selection to the firm's intake. Record missing files and their named owner. Retain the original files and describe any replacement or correction in the work note.

steps.title: Review the cash position
steps.instructions: Use the selected original cash records and the firm's reconciliation method. Record the cash position reviewed, the source dates and any unexplained difference. Assign each open question to the person who can supply its business context.

steps.title: Review upcoming receipts and obligations
steps.instructions: Review the supplied receivables, payable commitments and agreed near-term obligations for this period. Record the items requiring a decision, their dates and the responsible client contact. Keep the source assumptions with the work.

steps.title: Update the short-term cash outlook
steps.instructions: Apply the firm's existing forecast method to the supplied inputs. Separate observed balances from estimates, retain the assumptions and record material changes from the previous weekly review. Route decisions to the named finance lead.

steps.title: Review period cutoff and completeness
steps.instructions: Apply the firm's documented close checklist to the selected period. Record the supplied source coverage and any cutoff question requiring the responsible accountant's decision. Keep unresolved items visible in the reviewer handover.

steps.title: Complete the account reconciliations
steps.instructions: Use the firm's current reconciliation instructions and supplied schedules. Retain the working notes and supporting files, describe reconciling items and identify who owns any remaining correction.

steps.title: Review changes from the prior period
steps.instructions: Compare the supplied reporting schedules with the selected prior-period basis. Describe material changes under the firm's existing review policy. Record the client's explanation or an explicit unanswered question without substituting an assumption for their response.

steps.title: Prepare the monthly reporting handover
steps.instructions: Assemble the firm's agreed reporting schedules from the reviewed source material. Keep their dates and original file versions. Record any report qualification and the reviewer responsible for resolving it.

steps.title: Resolve and assign questions needing client context
steps.instructions: Collect questions about unfamiliar vendors, unusual charges, changes in operations and missing decisions. Record the named respondent, their answer and its date. Mark a task blocked with an explanation when a required answer remains outstanding.

steps.title: Prepare the reviewer handover
steps.instructions: Summarize completed work, source changes, corrections and remaining questions for the named reviewer. Record responsibility and due dates for follow-up. The reviewer returns corrections or explicitly approves the submitted work and any accepted open items.

profiles.name: Weekly cash review
profiles.description: Cash position, upcoming obligations, short-term outlook and questions requiring client context.

profiles.name: Monthly close
profiles.description: Period completeness, reconciliations, changes from the prior period and the reviewed reporting handover.
